recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for FHIR-core. If the current Citation page in the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG needs additional hyperlink cleanup, reconcile that external IG source separately rather than restoring the removed core Citation resource.
issue_request: FHIR-31875 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for R5 asking the Citation Resource page to add hyperlinks to referenced resources so navigation matched companion Evidence and EvidenceVariable resource pages.
initial_application: The Jira-linked commit af7ea5d38f9e6fe7c9ab5a05218a3a2b15ca7b49 touched source/citation/citation-introduction.xml as part of the 2021 CDS block-vote hyperlink family and applied companion Evidence and EvidenceVariable page links in the same commit.
additional_context: Citation is no longer an active FHIR-core resource: commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36 removed source/citation and active fhir.ini Citation entries. Current core narrative links Citation to the Evidence Based Medicine on FHIR IG and states the Citation Resource moved there. CDS Confluence minutes record FHIR-31875 as part of the approved 2021-06-23 block vote, and Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The target Citation Resource description page is outside the current FHIR-core build and checkout, so reintroducing source/citation or changing unrelated core pages would be out of scope for this hyperlink-only R5 issue.
